objective: Reconcile W0 evidence, card outcomes, residual UNKNOWN and W1 entry facts in the already activated tracked Program/ledger.
non_goals: Do not retroactively authorize work that lacked a frozen task packet.
Do not convert incomplete, stale or partial evidence into closure.
Do not modify Rust, Tauri, React or frontend product behavior.
Do not modify Rust, Tauri, React, frontend, CI, validator, schema, command, route, provider, Keychain, SecretStore, MCP audit, or product-data behavior.
Do not mutate predecessor integration, attempt, adjudication, packet, or attempt artifacts.
Do not close R3-N010, R3-N020, R4-FLAKY-001, BR4-D064, or any other finding.
Do not treat the injected native bootstrap harness as real Tauri, real OS Keychain, Settings/direct Keyring, external-provider, or product-data evidence.
Do not mark G-W0-EXTERNAL-STATE-ISOLATION PASS while NATIVE_TAURI and real external-state coverage remain uncredited.
Do not complete WAVE-0 or authorize WAVE-1 while any W0 exit gate remains blocked.
Do not reopen bounded or normal feature development.
invariant: W0 reconciliation must bind every living evidence subject to one current reviewed chain, settle every W0 card with an explicit non-closure carry outcome, keep BR4-D064 unchanged, pass only gates supported by exact credited dimensions, keep the real-Tauri external-state gate blocked, and preserve all residual UNKNOWN and no-external-action boundaries.
minimal_fix_contract: Verify the current receipts and authority only. The Integrator may later append state-only reconciliation facts, explicit carry outcomes, fail-closed gate statuses, and digest-addressed artifacts. No product or validator change is authorized, and the external-state gate must remain blocked unless exact NATIVE_TAURI plus EXTERNAL_STATE credit already exists.
old_path_deletion_contract: No deletion or replacement is authorized. Expected-absent product routes stay absent; all predecessor receipts, attempts, adjudications, packets, and artifacts stay immutable.
acceptance_criteria: Every W0 card and D064 prerequisite has an exact execution-SHA outcome; Program/ledger/active authority agree; unresolved evidence remains UNKNOWN.

The bare ongoing validator at baseline deterministically reproduces W0-LEDGER-MISSING-OR-STALE-RECEIPT because the prior reconciliation SHA does not cover the fresh W0-S3 recovery receipt and artifact commit.
The W0-S1 current coverage and selection contracts pass, and the evidence explicitly covers CI_FAULT, TEST_SIGNAL and TEST_SELECTION without granting finding closure.

The W0-S2 fixed owner-lease evidence passes the exact macOS arm64 20 focused plus 2 serial full-workspace repetition contract with no unexplained variation, while product impact and unsupported surfaces remain UNKNOWN.

The W0-S3 recovery evidence passes at the current source tree and preserves real Tauri, real OS Keychain, Settings/direct Keyring, transient sockets, sandbox-external filesystem, external Provider and product data as UNKNOWN or NOT_CREDITED.

G-W0-COVERAGE-TRUTH and G-W0-LEASE-DETERMINISM may receive current reviewed PASS wrappers; G-W0-EXTERNAL-STATE-ISOLATION must be BLOCKED with uncredited UNKNOWN evidence because NATIVE_TAURI is not proved.

R3-N010 and R3-N020 remain OPEN and carry to WAVE-4; R4-FLAKY-001 remains OPEN and carries to WAVE-3; their severity, disposition, owner, source, behavior, next proof, closure requirements, closure credit and closure record otherwise remain unchanged.
BR4-D064 remains byte-for-byte unchanged as a card; its effective W0-S3 recovery receipt is referenced only as the W1 prerequisite evidence.

G-W0-LEDGER-RECONCILIATION may PASS after every living evidence subject is covered, all three W0 cards have explicit current-SHA carry outcomes, active authority agrees, and an independent same-head challenge passes.
WAVE-0 becomes BLOCKED, not COMPLETE; WAVE-1 through WAVE-5 remain PLANNED_NOT_AUTHORIZED; all feature gates remain blocked.
All 101 cards remain present, closure_credit_true remains 0, explicit UNKNOWN remains visible, and no product or validator path changes.
The final state-only reconciliation passes the scoped and bare ongoing validators on a clean current chain, without treating validator success as finding, feature, trial, or Phase7 closure.
stop_conditions: Frozen source map or canonical owner is false.
A write is required outside allowed_touched_paths.
An expected-absent object would be recreated.
A required RED cannot be made to fail for the stated reason.
A closure-candidate proof has not failed before conditional implementation.
The same root cause has failed three implementation attempts.
The hard-stop size budget is exceeded; split the slice or stop for a successor Program.
External action or durable write needs authority not present in the packet.
Any predecessor receipt, attempt, adjudication, packet, artifact, baseline card identity, or immutable fact would change.
Any result would require G-W0-EXTERNAL-STATE-ISOLATION PASS without exact credited NATIVE_TAURI and EXTERNAL_STATE evidence.
Any result would complete WAVE-0, authorize a later Wave, reopen feature development, or grant finding, product-trial, or Phase7 closure while the external-state gate is blocked.
Any W0 card change other than one explicit forward-only carry outcome and current_wave transition would be required.
Any BR4-D064 card field would need to change during W0-S4.
Any external provider, real durable write, Keychain read/write/delete, or real product-data access would be required.
A credential, Keychain value, private product data, or unbounded log would enter an artifact.
A required surface is incomplete, stale, unsupported, or unattributable but would otherwise be reported as PASS instead of UNKNOWN.
ledger_update_contract: Only the Integrator may append the W0-S4 attempt and integration receipt, add current reviewed gate wrappers, append explicit carry outcomes for the three W0 cards, update current_wave counts and last_reconciled_execution_sha, and set WAVE-0 BLOCKED after a same-head independent challenge. BR4-D064, all closures, predecessor records, later gates/Waves, feature gates and UNKNOWN boundaries remain unchanged.
handoff_contract: Return exact baseline and reviewed head SHAs, every command result, the reproduced stale-reconciliation RED, exact gate credit/block decisions, three non-closure carry outcomes, unchanged BR4-D064/card and closure counts, residual UNKNOWN, confirmation of zero product/external actions, and independent challenge artifacts. Any unsupported PASS or scope expansion returns RED and stops.
